ei.subject: ReadingPower유형편완성

fullPassage: A soldier in one of the Prussian regiments had a watch chain of which he was very proud. Because he could not afford a watch, he used to wear a bullet attached to the chain's free end. One day Frederick the Great noticed this curious ornament and, deciding to have some fun with the man, took out his own diamond-studded watch. "My watch tells me that it is five o'clock," he said. "What time does yours tell?" Replied the soldier: "My watch does not tell me the hour, but tells me every minute that it is my duty to die for Your Majesty." Frederick was so pleased with this response that he handed his own watch over to the man, saying, "Take this so you may be able to tell the hour also."

questions.passage: A soldier in one of the Prussian regiments had a watch chain of which he was very (A)[proud / ashamed]. Because he could not (B)[afford / waste] a watch, he used to wear a bullet attached to the chain's free end. One day Frederick the Great noticed this curious ornament and, deciding to have some fun with the man, took out his own diamond-studded watch. "My watch tells me that it is five o'clock," he said. "What time does yours tell?" Replied the soldier: "My watch does not tell me the hour, but tells me every minute that it is my duty to die for Your Majesty." Frederick was so (C)[annoyed / pleased] with this response that he handed his own watch over to the man, saying, "Take this so you may be able to tell the hour also."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) proud(자랑스러운), (B) afford(~할 여유가 있다), (C) pleased(기뻐하는) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
✅ ① proud — afford — pleased: 원문 그대로 — 시겟줄을 자랑스러워했고, 시계를 살 여유가 없었으며, 대답에 기뻐했다 ←정답
❌ ② ashamed — afford — annoyed: ashamed(부끄러운)와 annoyed(짜증난)가 원문 반의어
❌ ③ proud — waste — annoyed: waste(낭비하다)와 annoyed가 원문 반의어
❌ ④ ashamed — waste — pleased: ashamed와 waste가 원문 반의어

questions.passage: A soldier in one of the Prussian regiments had a watch chain of which he was very proud. Because he could not afford a watch, he used to wear a bullet attached to the chain's free end. One day Frederick the Great (A)[noticed / overlooked] this (B)[curious / ordinary] ornament and, deciding to have some fun with the man, took out his own diamond-studded watch. "My watch tells me that it is five o'clock," he said. "What time does yours tell?" Replied the soldier: "My watch does not tell me the hour, but tells me every minute that it is my (C)[privilege / duty] to die for Your Majesty." Frederick was so pleased with this response that he handed his own watch over to the man, saying, "Take this so you may be able to tell the hour also."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) noticed(알아챘다), (B) curious(이상한/신기한), (C) duty(의무) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① overlooked(간과했다) — curious — duty: overlooked는 noticed의 반의어
❌ ② noticed — ordinary(평범한) — privilege(특권): ordinary와 privilege가 원문 반의어
❌ ③ overlooked — ordinary — privilege: 3개 모두 원문 반의어
✅ ④ noticed(알아챘다) — curious(이상한) — duty(의무): 원문과 일치 — 이상한 장신구를 알아챘고, 폐하를 위해 죽는 것이 의무라고 했다 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) attached(부착된), (B) response(대답), (C) handed(건네주었다) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① detached(분리된) — response — handed: detached는 attached의 반의어
❌ ② attached — silence(침묵) — withheld(보류했다): silence와 withheld가 원문 반의어
✅ ③ attached(부착된) — response(대답) — handed(건네주었다): 원문과 일치 — 총알을 시겟줄에 부착했고, 병사의 대답에 시계를 건네주었다 ←정답
❌ ④ detached — silence — handed: detached와 silence가 원문 반의어

Replied the soldier: "My watch does not tell me the hour, but tells me every minute that it is my duty to die for Your Majesty." questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② afford(여유가 있다) → waste(낭비하다): 시계를 살 여유가 없어서 총알을 달았는데, '낭비하다'는 부적절
det.analysis:
① proud(자랑스러운) ✅ 맥락 적절 — 시겟줄을 자랑스러워했다
② waste(낭비하다) ❌ 원문 afford(~할 여유가 있다) — 시계를 살 여유가 없어서 총알을 달았는데, '낭비하다'면 문맥 부적절 ←정답
③ bullet(총알) ✅ 맥락 적절 — 시겟줄 끝에 총알을 달았다
④ ornament(장신구) ✅ 맥락 적절 — 프레드릭이 이 이상한 장신구를 알아챘다

det.korean: ④ pleased(기뻐하는) → disappointed(실망한): 병사의 충성스러운 대답에 기뻐했는데, '실망한'은 부적절
det.analysis:
① regiments(연대) ✅ 맥락 적절 — 프로이센 연대의 한 병사

④ disappointed(실망한) ❌ 원문 pleased(기뻐하는) — 감동적인 대답에 시계까지 건네주었으므로 '실망한'은 문맥 모순 ←정답

det.analysis:

questions.passage:
(A) She <u>told</u> her friends about the exciting trip she had taken during the summer vacation.

(B) Can you <u>tell</u> the difference between the original painting and the copy?
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 tell의 의미로 가장 적절한 것을 각각 고르시오. (B)에 해당하는 것은?

det.korean: (A) tell = 말하다/이야기하다, (B) tell = 구별하다/분간하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① 말하다, 이야기하다: (A) 문맥에 해당 — 친구들에게 여행에 대해 '이야기했다'

✅ ② 구별하다, 분간하다: (B) 문맥에 해당 — 원본과 복사본의 차이를 '구별할' 수 있느냐 (tell the difference = 차이를 분간하다) ←정답

❌ ③ 명령하다, 지시하다: (A), (B) 어느 문맥에도 해당하지 않음

❌ ④ 알려주다, 가르쳐 주다: 본문에서 시계가 시간을 '알려주다'의 의미이나 (B)와는 다름
det.tip: tell: 말하다 / 구별하다(tell the difference) / 알려주다(tell the time)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a small piece of metal that is fired from a gun"

det.analysis:
❌ ① barrel(총신, 통): 총의 부품이지만 발사되는 금속 조각은 아님
❌ ② blade(칼날): 총과 무관한 무기 부품
❌ ③ shield(방패): 방어 장비로 발사체가 아님
✅ ④ bullet(총알): '총에서 발사되는 작은 금속 조각'이라는 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Because he could not afford a watch, he used to wear a bullet __________ (attach) to the chain's free end.

det.korean: attach → attached (과거분사): 시겟줄 끝에 부착된 총알
det.analysis: a bullet attached to the chain's free end: 총알이 시겟줄 끝에 '부착된' 상태. 명사(bullet) 뒤에서 수식하는 과거분사. attach(부착하다) → attached(부착된).
det.tip: 과거분사의 형용사적 용법: attached to = ~에 부착된

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: decide → deciding (현재분사): 재미를 보기로 결심하며
det.analysis: deciding to have some fun: 분사구문으로 주절의 주어(Frederick)와 동시 동작을 나타냄. decide(결심하다) → deciding(결심하며). 주어가 결심하는 능동 관계이므로 현재분사.
det.tip: 분사구문: 접속사+주어 생략 → 현재분사(-ing). deciding = as he decided

questions.passage: A soldier in one of the Prussian regiments had a watch chain of which he was very proud. Because he could not afford a watch, he used to wear a bullet attached to the chain's free end. One day Frederick the Great noticed this curious ornament and, deciding to __________ with the man, took out his own diamond-studded watch. "My watch tells me that it is five o'clock," he said. "What time does yours tell?" Replied the soldier: "My watch does not tell me the hour, but tells me every minute that it is my duty to die for Your Majesty." Frederick was so pleased with this response that he handed his own watch over to the man, saying, "Take this so you may be able to tell the hour also."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: have some fun(재미를 보다): 병사를 놀리기로 결심하고
det.analysis:
✅ ① have some fun(재미를 보다): 이상한 장신구를 보고 '재미를 보기로' 결심했다 — 자기 시계를 꺼내 시간을 물었다 ←정답
❌ ② make a deal(거래하다): 문맥상 거래가 아닌 장난
❌ ③ give an order(명령하다): 프레드릭이 명령한 것이 아닌 장난을 친 것
❌ ④ take a rest(쉬다): 문맥 무관
det.tip: have some fun with = ~를 놀리다, ~와 재미를 보다

questions.passage: A soldier in one of the Prussian regiments had a watch chain of which he was very proud. Because he could not afford a watch, he used to wear a bullet attached to the chain's free end. One day Frederick the Great noticed this curious ornament and, deciding to have some fun with the man, took out his own diamond-studded watch. "My watch tells me that it is five o'clock," he said. "What time does yours tell?" Replied the soldier: "My watch does not tell me the hour, but tells me every minute that it is my duty to die for Your Majesty." Frederick was so pleased with this response that he handed his own watch over to the man, saying, "Take this so you may be able to __________ also."

det.korean: tell the hour(시간을 알다): 네가 시간도 알 수 있도록 이것을 가져라
det.analysis:
❌ ① save his life(목숨을 구하다): 시계를 준 이유와 맞지 않음
❌ ② join the army(군대에 입대하다): 이미 군인이므로 문맥 무관
✅ ③ tell the hour(시간을 알다): 프레드릭이 자기 시계를 건네며 '시간도 알 수 있도록' 하라고 했다 ←정답
❌ ④ earn a reward(보상을 받다): 시계를 준 것은 보상이 아닌 감사의 표현이며, 원문 표현과 다름
det.tip: tell the hour = tell the time = 시간을 알다
